name: SWEET BY AND BY
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of In the Sweet By and By (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/In_the_Sweet_By_and_By/, “Sweet By and By”, Joseph P. Webster, 1868), whose music it marks public domain; only the tune was taken, not the harmony (the lower voices’ echoes in the refrain are left out). Its opening agrees with hymnary.org’s incipit 12321 21651 23335 (https://hymnary.org/tune/sweet_by_and_by_webster) and CCEH’s drmrdrdls (https://www.ccel.org/cceh/0004/x000495.htm). No hand fixes. Webster’s dates (1819–1875) and the year 1868 are from https://hymnary.org/tune/sweet_by_and_by_webster.
